subject: embedded_terminal_v1
operator_observation: Terminal -> Start Session -> no visible result

root_cause.mechanism: First-run walkthrough render() unconditionally wrote store panel to the tour step; the async onboarding check could auto-open after the operator navigated, mounting the terminal panel and then forcing panel back to command-center (stage hidden again).
root_cause.live_race_evidence: Dev stack, headless Edge: click TERMINAL at t0 -> panel=terminal, stage visible; walkthrough auto-opened at t~2s -> panel reverted to command-center (pre-fix). Post-fix: walkthrough opens at t~2s and panel stays terminal.
root_cause.why_intermittent: Clicking after the auto-open stuck; clicking during the load window reverted.

fix.walkthrough: render(navigate) navigates only on explicit intent; first-run auto-open never overrides operator navigation and aligns to the operator's current panel instead; manual open and BACK/NEXT keep real panel switching; operator navigation tracked while the tour is closed.
fix.provider_timeout: terminalProviders() read timeout raised to 45s for the cold provider discovery probe (measured 4.6s warm; one cold run exceeded the previous 15s read timeout).
